label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group diagnostic PET imaging study where all participants receive the same scans, not a placebo-controlled treatment trial. The only comparator described is a blocking study using ketoprofen, which is an active inhibitor, plus healthy volunteers for comparison; no inactive placebo is described.

evidence.quote: All subjects receive the same tests

title: PET Imaging of Cyclooxygenases in Neurodegenerative Brain Disease
